capabilities: Save LINE text messages as notes automatically or on demand
Download LINE photos into the vault
Transcribe LINE voice messages to text via Whisper
Organize notes with date-based folders and filename templates
Check plan, quota, and upgrade status through LINE bot commands
disambiguation: Sync is one-way only: messages flow from LINE to Obsidian, never the reverse.
extras: Freemium: Free plan allows 10 images and 10 transcriptions total; Premium is ¥300/month via Stripe. Desktop only (no mobile). Text and images are end-to-end encrypted but voice transcription is not, since audio is processed server-side. Includes a rate-limit mechanism for accounts listed in a Worker secret.
problem: Messages sent in LINE cannot be automatically captured as searchable notes in an Obsidian vault.

relations.evidence: A plugin that connects Obsidian with LINE.
voice messages are sent to Cloudflare Workers AI (Whisper) for transcription

requires.name: LINE User ID registration with the plugin
Premium plan (¥300/month) for unlimited images and voice transcription

summary: Syncs LINE chat messages into Obsidian notes, with image saving, voice transcription via Cloudflare Workers AI, and folder/naming templates.
